SELECT CAST(SUM(T1.UpVotes) AS REAL) / COUNT(T1.Id), CAST(SUM(T1.Age) AS REAL) / COUNT(T1.Id)
FROM users AS T1
INNER JOIN (
  SELECT T2.OwnerUserId
  FROM posts AS T2
  WHERE T2.OwnerUserId IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY T2.OwnerUserId
  HAVING COUNT(T2.OwnerUserId) > 10
) AS T3 ON T1.Id = T3.OwnerUserId

SELECT CAST(SUM(T1.UpVotes) AS REAL) / COUNT(T1.Id), CAST(SUM(T1.Age) AS REAL) / COUNT(T1.Id) FROM users AS T1 INNER JOIN ( SELECT T2.OwnerUserId FROM posts AS T2 WHERE T2.OwnerUserId IS NOT NULL GROUP BY T2.OwnerUserId HAVING COUNT(T2.OwnerUserId) > 10 ) AS T3 ON T1.Id = T3.OwnerUserId

SELECT CAST((SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN b.bond_type = '-' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) FROM bond AS b INNER JOIN molecule AS m ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id WHERE m.label = '+') AS REAL) / (SELECT COUNT(a.atom_id) FROM atom AS a INNER JOIN molecule AS m ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id WHERE m.label = '+')

SELECT CAST((SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN b.bond_type = '-' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) FROM bond AS b INNER JOIN molecule AS m ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id WHERE m.label = '+') AS REAL) / (SELECT COUNT(a.atom_id) FROM atom AS a INNER JOIN molecule AS m ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id WHERE m.label = '+')

SELECT CAST(COUNT(*) AS REAL) * 100.0 / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM molecule WHERE label = '+') AS percentage FROM molecule AS m LEFT JOIN atom AS a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id AND a.element = 'f' WHERE m.label = '+' AND a.atom_id IS NULL;
